import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a1,b0,b1,c0,c1,c2,d0,d1,d2,d3 = params[:10]
    A=a1/T
    p=b0+b1/T
    q=c0+c1/T+c2/T**2
    C=d0+d1*T+d2*T**2+d3/T
    return A*eps**p*np.exp(-q*eps)+C
